Most people float through life like a ship with no rudder.

Kevin Trudeau says most people have never decided what they want, because defining it takes time and effort. So they drift wherever the wind and the waves take them.

A few take charge. They fire up the engine, know exactly where they are going, and get there whatever the weather does.

Kevin calls that being the master of your own destiny.

If you stopped drifting today, where would you point the boat?

#ad #success #mindset #goals

Every time you shook his hand, he said the same sentence.

Kevin Trudeau tells of Ken Norton, the heavyweight champion who beat Muhammad Ali. Norton started from zero and became successful in business after boxing.

He greeted everyone with Napoleon Hill's words: whatever the mind of man can conceive and believe, it can achieve.

What is the one sentence you repeat to yourself?
